scenes.prompt: Three bored children aged 7 to 10 follow a French mother around the kitchen in a line like ducklings, one dragging a blanket, one sighing dramatically, one holding an empty ball, the mother holds a coffee cup with an amused, slightly desperate smile.

In a cozy home hallway, three children aged 7 to 10 put on cardboard knight armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume, eyes wide with excitement, while a smiling parent shows them an old rolled treasure map, the front door open onto a sunny street.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet solve a riddle together in front of an old half-timbered Alsatian house: one counts the windows with a pointing finger, one holds a magnifying glass, one scratches his head thinking, geranium flower boxes. Plain surfaces, no inscriptions.

A big group of eight children aged 7 to 10, friends and cousins of different looks, dressed as knights with crowns and red plumed helmets, cheer and give high fives in a sunny flowery Alsatian village square with half-timbered houses and a stone fountain.
